# Graphene Security

> UK retailer selling Google Pixel phones with GrapheneOS pre-installed.
> Privacy-focused smartphones, custom-prepared per order. Prices in GBP.

Graphene Security sells de-googled Google Pixel smartphones (Pixel 6 through
Pixel 10 series, Pixel Fold and Pixel 9 Pro Fold) with GrapheneOS — the
privacy and security hardened mobile operating system — installed and
verified before shipping.

## Key facts

- Currency: GBP (£)
- Payment: PayPal (guest checkout available — no account required)
- Preparation: each phone is custom-flashed and security-checked on demand
- Shipping: UK delivery, typically 3-5 days after preparation
- Returns: 28 days from delivery
- Support: support@graphene-security.com

- [All GrapheneOS phones](https://graphene-security.com/products): full catalog with prices and stock

- [Flashing service](https://graphene-security.com/flash-service): send us your own Pixel to flash
- [Contact](https://graphene-security.com/contact-us): support and enquiries

## About GrapheneOS

GrapheneOS is a privacy and security focused mobile operating system based on
the Android Open Source Project, offering hardened exploit mitigations,
enhanced permission controls, no pre-installed Google services, and optional
sandboxed Google Play compatibility. The official project site is
https://grapheneos.org — Graphene Security is an independent UK retailer of
devices pre-installed with it.
